Grown-ups

Popcorn words

The class sight word lists, worked in order. Tap "Use this list" for the list she's on, or tap single words to mix 2 she knows with 3 new ones. Small numbers show how often she got it right on the first try.

Clinic letters

The sounds Dr. Clinic asks about. Start with the class letter of the week plus a few she's learning.

Robot level

Level 1 uses only sounds she already knows. Move up when a level feels easy.

Bug Jar

How high the numbers go. The class is on 0 to 5 and starting 6 and 7.

Frog Hop

How far the lily pads go, and how big the die is.

Voice

The games read words out loud in a recorded voice. If there's no sound, turn the phone's volume up and check the ringer switch.

Start fresh

Clears her stars and the first-try counts on this device. Your word, letter and level choices stay.
